t2i_prompt: Flat vector engineering sheet on limestone paper, optionally set on deep navy. Uppercase monospace headline top-left and a small title block top-right. Numbered steps with large steel-blue mono numerals follow a serpentine double-line pipe with elbows and inline valve symbols, left to right then back. Selected steps sit inside heavier double-frame boxes with a tilted steel-blue stamp and a signature line beneath. Small arrows show flow; a dot grid patch fills a corner. <CONTENT>. Hairline navy strokes, no shadows.

weaknesses: serpentine path breaks on narrow screens
